description: One row for each school the playlist store holds a policy, an index run, a playlist or a build request for, ordered by state, then school name. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key; any other caller is refused. Takes no argument. Each row gives unitid, and name and state as the publish this host serves holds them (null where it holds no such school); index, the school's latest academic policy index run as playlist_index_status reads it (status none, running, done or failed; current; publish_version; finished_at; error; policy_pages; left_out); pages_to_read, the count of the page list kept with the policy in use, null where none is kept; last_build, the school's newest build request of either kind by the time it was asked (request_id, rebuild_policy, checklist_id, status, requested_at, error, published_only, timed_out, policy_fallback, attempt_errors, not_read, the counts of policy_warnings and playlist_warnings, policy_pages_read and policy_characters_read), never its learners, null where none is held; policy_in_use, the newest policy that is a draft, not rejected and passed its checks (trust_state, source, created_at), null where none; playlists, the count of the school's checklists with a playlist in use; and open_orders, the count of its rebuild orders open or taken. A value the store does not hold is null. Read-only: nothing is built or kept, and no model is called.
name: playlist_schools
title: Playlist Schools
